episodes.title: Brave Search API Adds Agentic Crypto Payments

scenes.narration: Brave just dropped a massive update to their Search API, and AI agents can now pay for data using crypto!
scenes.visual_prompt: Isometric 3D Pixel Art of a glowing web browser API interface connecting to a crypto wallet, vibrant cyber neon lighting, 9:16 vertical

scenes.narration: Instead of traditional credit cards, autonomous AI agents can instantly settle micro-transactions for real-time web searches.
scenes.visual_prompt: Isometric 3D Pixel Art of a tiny robotic AI agent handing over glowing digital coins to a search server, vibrant lighting, 9:16 vertical

scenes.narration: This is the missing link for fully autonomous AI workflows. Are we entering the age of machine-to-machine economies?
scenes.visual_prompt: Isometric 3D Pixel Art of a futuristic city grid powered by glowing crypto blocks and data streams, vibrant lighting, 9:16 vertical
